title: Unclassified assignment literal: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]
summary: Synthetic Unclassified assignment literal values built to the documented format appear in 12 inputs. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: An arbitrary literal in a sensitive field is a masking-policy case, not a provider-format ground truth.
